question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Titanic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Titanic"** means something of exceptional strength, size, or power. (विशालकाय)

 
 
• **Example: **The construction of the skyscraper was a titanic effort that took several years to complete.
 
 
 
• **"Huge" **refers to something very large in size or amount. (बहुत बड़ा)
 
 
• **Example: **The whale is a huge creature that dominates the ocean.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Titanic' **is **'Huge'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deep **(गहरा): Extending far down from the top or surface.

 
 
• **Example:** The ocean is incredibly deep in some places.
 
 
 
• **Disastrous **(विनाशकारी): Causing great damage.
 
 
• **Example: **The earthquake had a disastrous impact on the city.
 
 
 
• **Attractive** (आकर्षक): Pleasing or appealing to the senses.
 
 
• **Example:** The garden is very attractive in the spring.
